# The command `bondi setup` runs to start an orchestrator, produced by Bondi's
# own client rather than transcribed. Generated: do not edit by hand. `dune
# runtest` regenerates and diffs it, and `dune promote` accepts a change.
#
# One line per rootless-sensitive deployment shape, which is not one line
# per deployment shape. The command varies on two config inputs; the two
# lines below are the one that moves the flags a rootless engine
# reinterprets: `no-cron` and, with cron jobs configured, `cron`, which
# additionally carries `--user root`, the spool mount and the
# /etc/bondi/cron payload mount. The other input is the image tag, which
# the script reading this file substitutes for the one under test.
#
# `bondi_server.bind_address` and `bondi_server.api_token` are named here
# because they used to be the other two inputs and are now neither: the
# orchestrator publishes no port and is passed no environment, so the
# fields are read out of bondi.yaml, reported to the operator as dead and
# dropped. There is no value of either that these two lines fail to
# cover. The residue the older wording recorded -- that everything
# asserted through these lines is asserted against an unauthenticated
# API -- went with the API.
no-cron docker run -d --name bondi-orchestrator --restart unless-stopped -v /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock --group-add $(stat -c %g /var/run/docker.sock) --label bondi.managed=true --label bondi.type=infrastructure --label bondi.logs=true mlopez1506/bondi-server:0.12.0
cron docker run -d --name bondi-orchestrator --restart unless-stopped -v /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock -v /var/spool/cron/crontabs:/var/spool/cron/crontabs -v /etc/bondi/cron:/etc/bondi/cron --user root --group-add $(stat -c %g /var/run/docker.sock) --label bondi.managed=true --label bondi.type=infrastructure --label bondi.logs=true mlopez1506/bondi-server:0.12.0
